questions.text: It's the day before your final Board Exams. What is your 'secret' strategy?

options.A: Trusting your strong 'gut feeling' to predict exactly which 5-mark questions will definitely come in the paper.
options.B: Making sure you use your specific 'lucky pen' and wearing the lucky watch that helped you top the pre-boards.
options.C: Creating beautifully colour-coded mind maps and using specific highlighter colours to calm your mind.
options.D: Organizing a strict group-study timetable on WhatsApp and keeping all your friends focused and on track.

questions.text: You randomly glance at your phone and the time is exactly 11:11. What is your reaction?

options.A: You instantly close your eyes, make a wish, and feel a strong positive energy from the universe.
options.B: You start adding up the digits of the date and time to see if they match your own birth date's numbers.
options.C: You take a quick aesthetic screenshot of the lock screen to post on your Instagram story with a sparkly song.
options.D: You notice how big the '11:11 manifestation' trend is online and wonder how many views it gets.

questions.text: Your classmate just added an extra 'a' to their name (e.g., Ayush to Aayush) for good luck. What do you do?

options.A: You talk to them to see how they are feeling and if the new name is bringing them more positive vibes.
options.B: You try to mathematically calculate the alphabet values to find the logic behind why the Panditji suggested the extra 'a'.
options.C: You take their notebook and practice writing their new spelling in cool, aesthetic calligraphy fonts.
options.D: You remind them about the massive headache of changing the spelling on their Aadhar Card and CBSE registration.

questions.text: Your friend group is playing 'Raja Mantri Chor Sipahi' with paper chits. What's your focus?

options.A: Looking at everyone's faces—you can instantly sense who got the 'Chor' chit just by their expressions.
options.B: Keeping a mental track of the patterns to predict the probability of who will pick 'Raja' in the next round.
options.C: Being the one who beautifully folds the paper chits and draws tiny crowns or stars on them.
options.D: Taking charge of the game, keeping the scores in a diary, and making sure nobody is cheating.

questions.text: You get a strong 'gut feeling' that a friend in your tuition class is lying to you. What is your move?

options.A: You pull them aside, look them in the eye, and ask them directly because you can easily read their energy.
options.B: You cross-check their story with facts, dates, and timings to logically prove the loopholes in their lie.
options.C: You observe their body language and micro-expressions, drawing mental pictures of how they are acting weird.
options.D: You handle the drama quietly, warning the rest of the group to be careful without making a huge scene.

questions.text: You go to a Diwali Mela and see a parrot card reader / fortune teller sitting in a corner. What catches your attention?

options.A: You want to sit down immediately, ask them a personal question about your future, and talk to them.
options.B: You try to decode their system—how many cards they use and the probability of the parrot picking a 'good' card.
options.C: You stare at the beautiful, vintage artwork on the cards and the mysterious setup of the stall.
options.D: You observe the crowd and calculate how much profit they are making per hour from the Mela visitors.

questions.text: Your mom tells you to wear a specific 'lucky colour' (like yellow) for a big family puja. How do you approach this?

options.A: You embrace the positive energy of the colour and feel it uplifting your mood during the function.
options.B: You ask your parents exactly which astrological or numeric rule makes yellow lucky for Thursdays.
options.C: You spend time perfectly styling the yellow outfit with the best accessories to make sure your photos look great.
options.D: You wear the colour without fuss, but your main focus is making sure your family leaves the house on time.

questions.text: Your best friend is extremely anxious before giving a speech in the school assembly. How do you help?

options.A: Holding their hands, giving them an emotional pep talk, and calming their nerves with your soothing voice.
options.B: Reminding them of their past test scores and the number of times they practiced, using logic to boost confidence.
options.C: Giving them a small 'lucky charm' bracelet or a crystal you bought to keep in their pocket for good vibes.
options.D: Making sure their mic is working, their script is in order, and managing all the background stress for them.

questions.text: When you think about 'Spirituality' or the 'Mystic' world, what fascinates you the most?

options.A: The ability to heal people, listen to their deep problems, and guide them out of sadness.
options.B: The hidden codes, life path numbers, and ancient mathematics that predict human behavior.
options.C: The mysterious aesthetics, beautiful tarot cards, glowing crystals, and incense smoke.
options.D: The massive community—how people build entire platforms, apps, and businesses around giving advice.

questions.text: If you started an Instagram page today, what would it be about?

options.A: Doing 'Live Sessions' where followers ask you questions and you give them instant, comforting advice.
options.B: Making informative reels explaining the meaning behind birth dates and why repeating numbers matter.
options.C: Posting extremely aesthetic photos of crystals, tarot cards, and beautiful spiritual quotes.
options.D: Promoting workshops, collaborating with famous astrologers, and selling tickets to online healing events.

Live Tarot Reader.title: The Intuitive Guide (Live Tarot Reader)
Live Tarot Reader.primary_match_text: You are deeply intuitive, empathetic, and amazing at reading people's energies! You love interacting directly with others and have a natural talent for making people feel heard and comforted. As a Tarot Reader, you would use your intuition to guide people through their toughest times.
Live Tarot Reader.day_in_the_life: Your day involves setting up a calm, peaceful space, getting on Zoom calls or meeting clients in person. You pull cards, listen to people's relationship or career problems, and use the deck to give them deeply personal, live guidance.
Live Tarot Reader.alternative_match_text: If not in the Occult space, you would make an incredible Psychologist, Counselor, or Life Coach.
Live Tarot Reader.educational_roadmap: Take Arts/Humanities in 11th/12th. Pursue a BA in Psychology to understand human behavior deeply. Alongside, take private certifications from recognized Tarot experts to master the cards.

Numerology Analyst.title: The Pattern Decoder (Numerology Analyst)
Numerology Analyst.primary_match_text: You have an analytical mind that loves finding logic in chaos! You don't just believe in 'magic'; you believe in math, patterns, and systems. As a Numerology Analyst, you would decode birth dates, life path numbers, and name spellings to predict people's futures.
Numerology Analyst.day_in_the_life: You sit with grids, charts, and calculators. A client comes to you wanting to name their new startup or newborn baby, and you use ancient mathematical formulas to find the exact 'lucky' spelling that will bring them success.
Numerology Analyst.alternative_match_text: If not in the Occult space, you would thrive as a Data Analyst, Researcher, or Financial Forecaster.
Numerology Analyst.educational_roadmap: Take Science or Commerce (with Math) in 11th/12th to keep your analytical skills sharp. Pursue a B.Sc in Mathematics or Statistics. Complete private, professional courses in Vedic or Chaldean Numerology.

Tarot Deck / Mystic Artist.title: The Mystic Creator (Tarot Deck / Mystic Artist)
Tarot Deck / Mystic Artist.primary_match_text: You are a creative soul who is drawn to the mysterious and aesthetic side of life! You have a great eye for design, colours, and symbols. As a Mystic Artist, you would bring the spiritual world to life by designing beautiful tarot decks, aura posters, and crystal jewelry.
Tarot Deck / Mystic Artist.day_in_the_life: Your day is spent in an art studio or on an iPad. You illustrate stunning, mysterious artwork for new tarot cards, photograph healing crystals for Instagram, and design the visual identity for spiritual brands.
Tarot Deck / Mystic Artist.alternative_match_text: If not in the Occult space, you would excel as an Illustrator, Graphic Designer, or Art Director.
Tarot Deck / Mystic Artist.educational_roadmap: Take Arts/Humanities in 11th/12th. Pursue a Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) or a degree in Graphic Design from institutes like NID or NIFT. Build a strong portfolio around mystic and spiritual themes.

Occult Platform Manager.title: The Spiritual Entrepreneur (Occult Platform Manager)
Occult Platform Manager.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader and organizer! You see the big picture and know how to turn a passion into a booming community. As an Occult Platform Manager, you wouldn't necessarily read the cards yourself; you would build the business, manage the astrologers, and scale the brand.
Occult Platform Manager.day_in_the_life: You are managing a popular spiritual app or wellness center. You schedule client bookings, market upcoming online Tarot workshops, negotiate with famous astrologers, and manage the digital presence of the business.
Occult Platform Manager.alternative_match_text: If not in the Occult space, you would be a powerful Event Manager, Digital Marketer, or Startup Founder.
Occult Platform Manager.educational_roadmap: Take Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA or B.Com. Focus heavily on Digital Marketing, Community Management, and PR courses. The ultimate goal is an MBA to help you build and scale a massive spiritual tech platform.
